caption: How to heal during sleep #wellness #usahealth #wellnessjourney #healthybodyhealthymind #wellnessjourney
transcript: Put a raw onion on the bottom of your feet before bed and watch what happens to how you sleep. My friend, this is something Western medicine will never tell you, because there is no profit in something this simple. Your feet hold over 7,000 nerve endings connected to every organ you carry. While you sleep, your body pulls the weight of the day downward. Toward the feet, the place farthest from the heart, the place it has always known how to release through. The onion does not heal you. It draws. It pulls what your body has already been trying to let go of all day and gives it somewhere to go. This is why in the morning, some people wake and the onion has turned dark, even foul. Not because the onion is dying, because it did its work while you slept. Try it tonight, my friend. Cut. Place. Sleep. And in the morning, notice. The head a little clearer, the body a little lighter, the sleep deeper than it has been in some time. There is one more step in this practice, the one that makes it work even better, and almost no one knows it. I put the full ritual and the reason behind it in my book, linked in my bio.
